source_caption:
The viral dance scene in M3GAN became so iconic because it turns something playful into something deeply unsettling. The sudden shift from creepy stillness to perfectly choreographed movement makes M3GAN feel less like a broken machine and more like a performer who understands exactly how terrifying she is.

M3GAN (2022), directed by Gerard Johnstone, starring Allison Williams, Violet McGraw, Amie Donald. A sharp and entertaining techno-horror film about an artificial intelligence doll whose protective programming turns into something dangerous, blending camp, satire, and killer-doll terror.

source_details.synopsis: M3GAN is a 2022 American science fiction horror film with black comedy elements about an artificially intelligent doll who develops self-awareness and becomes hostile toward anyone who comes between her and her human companion. It was directed by Gerard Johnstone from a screenplay by Akela Cooper, based on a story by Cooper and James Wan. Allison Williams and Violet McGraw star, Amie Donald physically portrays M3GAN, and Jenna Davis voices the character. It is the first installment in the M3GAN film series. M3GAN premiered in Los Angeles on December 7, 2022, and Universal Pictures theatrically released it in the United States on January 6, 2023. The film grossed over $181 million worldwide a
